data.body:
Closed as **duplicate of 408c-9c78-c523-4d1c (sunbeamy-uber-polliwog)**.

The deploy-key-materializer signal gap this ticket describes (Instance 1: infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh missing from CONFIG_PATHS in infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh) was implemented and merged under 408c as Gerrit change 2444 (commit f87719be9999), now on origin/main. Verified on origin/main: CONFIG_PATHS now enumerates materialize-deploy-key.sh, and the RED->GREEN regression tests exist (tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py for instance 1; tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py for instance 2). Sibling broke-choleric-hound (5d4c, Instance 2) already closed plan_defect against the same change.

Defect origin/attribution stays on 408c (closed plan_defect) to avoid double-counting the escape. No further work needed here.
